programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
才駿Hashtag 南方東英ETF 指南粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 饒宗頤文化館被列為歷史建築，因此範圍內出現大型蜂巢，也難以引入重型機械來清除，蜂患問題最終如何圓滿解決？一名智力受限的男子外出遇人搭訕並誘導至健身中心，更被安排驗精。中心職員聲稱事主的精子含量偏低，並以增加魅力吸引異性為由，遊說事主購買逾二十萬元療程。事主家人批評健身中心的銷售手法並要求全額退款，但中心僅願意退回部分款項……天王級藝人劉德華出席連鎖式餐飲機構舉辦的慈善活動，送上花絮片段。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2789粵
programme.desc: 力蓮發現不少員工午膳後遲遲未返回崗位，源於多了新客人在Cafe長期「打躉」有關，遂設法解決。另一邊廂，尚善不喜坐困辦公室，反而到Cafe工作，辦公方式更「親民」且靈活，效率大增。某公司更因認同尚善的理念，與接龍合作，帶來利益。尚善獲敢威讚賞，力蓮不甘示弱，也長駐Cafe，Andy、Ivan遂往該處博取表現，獲力蓮稱讚並得到好處。其他人仿傚，紛紛湧到Cafe工作，引發不少問題……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#16粵PG
programme.desc: 邵玲探望感化少年卻差點受傷，被跟蹤而至的雅文目睹；其後，少年遭偷襲打傷。惠知與邵玲相聚時巧遇雅文，對眼前少女留下印象……勵梅出獄後，一反常態向邵玲道歉，邵玲心軟，邵文卻對此極度反感，剛巧家中名錶不翼而飛，邵文懷疑是勵梅所偷。邵文審理「少女殺貓案」，被告正是雅文。惠知覺得殺貓案背後或有隱情，主動瞭解案件詳情，思義不解為何惠知要如此關注虐待動物的案件……邵玲認為是雅文所做，卻不明白她要堅持不認罪……

programme.title: 大生意人#11粵普
programme.desc: 萬茶大會當日，平原巧遇微服前來的慈禧，慈禧想嘗蘭雪茶，平原為她泡茶，並對萬茶大會只為斂財而感憤憤不平。紫軒扮作丫鬟奉茶，平原心感不妙，阻止慈禧喝下她的茶。恭親王被慈禧訓斥一番，平原則獲賜匾天下第一茶。

programme.title: 試真D粵PG
programme.desc: 深圳有賓館被指「照騙」，嘉洛實地視察，瞓身記錄最真實的負評報告。為迎合美儀姐的滋補要求，節目組悉心安排瓦煲湯水專門店。朱仔從容享用「牛鞭湯」兼吃湯渣，表情管理失敗的GM亦衝破底線，試試「蠍子湯」。超市新食品「紅黑榜」大檢閱，團隊為觀眾「試真D」！「紅品」肉鬆法包名不符實，「黑品」牛肉餅卻獲平反？包裝鳳爪竟吃出洗潔精味道；榴芒班戟又可否令抗拒榴槤的GM扭轉態度？另追加整蠱坤哥大作戰，咖啡杯藏彩蛋……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

programme.desc: 文靜欲離開國棟與家聰一起，家聰不捨與簡潔多年感情而婉拒。簡潔知國棟替家聰隱瞞婚外情，大罵國棟，反被國棟責須自我檢討。家聰終承認有婚外情，並求簡潔原諒。家聰向文靜提出分手，文靜無法接受。簡潔開心與家聰的問題得已解決，決定提早休假陪家聰旅行。簡潔意外再目睹家聰與文靜親熱，精神陷入崩潰，更缺席談判行動。國棟查問簡潔缺席原因，簡潔不忍將實情告知，只囑其不要忽略家庭。楊光與可人初次行動表現突出，備受讚賞。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 現代都市人手機不離手，過度依賴或引致「手機失智症」。精神科醫生指此症並非正式的醫學診斷，情況卻與老人失智症有些相似。過度使用手機，除了可能令專注力下降，甚至會出現社交障礙。要防止這情況，醫生有何建議？嘉賓謝寧坦言與岑建勳離婚後仍相信愛情，並慶幸遇上現任丈夫。她呼籲女性不應為照顧家庭而失去自我，還談到緣何認為不需為下一代預留過多財富，以及與前夫相處之道。「睇餸食飯」環節，陳國賓示範「芝麻蒟蒻炒雞」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵

programme.title: 五味人生#11粵
programme.desc: 永禎發著高燒，誤以為雙春等帶警察捉拿自己，不分情由襲擊她；九妹為了讓雙春帶永禎逃走，竟扮永禎奪門而逃。雙春探望九妹，九妹認為廿年前得永禎相救，所以要替他頂罪。永禎發現雙春與九妹原是舊識，決定游說勝天出手救九妹。中毒之事告一段落，飛揚公布雙春的喜相逢酒樓勝出烹飪比賽，並履行承諾收九妹為徒。永禎、雙春及九妹決定不計前事，重新結為好友。在慈善競投舞伴環節，勝天故意競投失敗，賣魚勝投得與金鳳共舞的權利……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#79粵
programme.desc: 在放暑期的婷主動跟朋學煮鮑魚粥，原來婷扮乖巧，只為見偶像「側膊」，朋得悉後大怒，更責她膚淺。喜以一身韓服出現，原來喜的韓國偶像誠俊哥即將來港，故特打扮去接機。喜為了偶像表現瘋狂，甚至棄藥房的生意不顧。

programme.title: 尚食#19粵普
programme.desc: 姚子衿不顧手上傷痛，堅持參與上元佳宴，孟尚食允准。子衿的手傷不知能否完全康復，於是她將這次比試視作最後機會。上元佳宴的比試將以獲得皇上讚好的菜式數目多寡決勝負，比試中，兩位尚食各有千秋，難分高下。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.desc: 消防員欲破門而入，原來家中傳出不明氣體只是婷不潔的球鞋發出氣味。大廈維修停水停電，眾人上街擔水，缺少運動的眾人均不支。有義、有情及溢滿見勢色不對，竟計劃集體逃亡。可是蕙婷發燒厲害，溢滿取消逃亡行動。

programme.title: 尚食#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿親自送膳，憑口才令皇上留下孟尚食送來的幾道菜。胡尚食準備的炮豚呈現祥瑞圖紋博得皇上歡心，明火卻不慎點燃龍袍。宴席突現刺客，瞻基因護駕不力遭皇上指責。胡尚食自知落敗，邀子衿見面，而後借月華之手自盡。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 手工豆製品買少見少，鼎爺與阿譚到老字號豆品廠，見識豆製品的製作過程。自家製豆漿的豆渣不浪費，鼎爺教路用來配鴨蛋、韭菜等製作「豆香餅」，不妨以豆漿伴吃。鼎爺再以鶴藪、花蛤配搭豆漿炮製菜式，先下花蛤到豆漿中略煮，再加入鶴藪吸收豆漿的鮮甜味。蟬蛻營養豐富，還可用來製作牛腩煲，亦有改善肉質的作用。燜煮菜式宜採用蓮藕的哪部份？注意燜煮技巧以及下材料的次序。鼎爺再以蟬蛻煲「豬腱藥膳湯」，各式藥材有何功效？

流行都市粵
programme.desc: 太極樂隊成軍四十年，五子到臨錄影廠，暢談巡唱香港站內容及往後的巡唱計劃。合作難免有分歧，他們卻認為成員之間互相欣賞，是眾人可夾Band足四十年的原因！他們更會即席高歌一曲<頂天立地。轉季易令人出現氣管問題，而室內空氣質素低亦可引致不適，室內環境有何通常存在的污染物？使用空氣清新劑，或會令情況適得其反？此外，呼吸系統科醫生亦帶來有助改善家居空氣質素的方法。「睇餸食飯」，三姐奉上「芝麻醋香軟殼蟹」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵

programme.desc: 永禎向雙春與九妹提到將到飛揚的貿易公司工作。永禎隨曼娣與勝天出外入貨選購人參，當曼娣二人到另一處查看貨辦之際，竟有店員刻意接近永禎欲行賄他……永禎與利是妹談到營商比做老千更易賺錢，更想借此機會了解父親犯事原因。若嵐吃了飛揚所製的水餃，憶起昔日回憶。勝天與金鳳遊郊外，兩人感情又邁進一步。飛揚發覺若嵐特意約永禎到關家，要他吃若嵐自己所包的水餃，心生不滿。飛揚夢到昔日自己如何妒忌若嵐與安山的關係。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐告訴蜻蛉自己過去所犯的錯，希望她不要像自己那樣後悔莫及，加上阿圓奪標的消息，終令蜻蛉下定決心跟五十嵐前往惡礫島。兩人幾經辛苦找到垢多，並獲得對方批准挑戰其設計的高難度球洞。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 色弱是指分辨顏色的能力較正常低，最普遍的是紅綠色弱，少部分患者是藍黃色弱，大多都是先天性的，是透過X染色體去遺傳的，所以男性的病發率比女性高十六倍，如果是後天色弱，有機會是單眼病發，但先天性的就一定是雙眼病發。色弱沒有醫治方法，不過一般對生活影響不大，但可透過特殊鏡片輔助日常生活。

滙豐保險呈獻：準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.desc: 城安、凌凌與壯出席某網友的喪禮，發現家屬對死者並不了解，導致喪禮錯漏百出。城安有感熊家眾人絕不可靠，擔心自己會重複該位網友的情況，於是預先擬定身後事的細節，包括找人照顧科莫多龍小Bon等各種事項。萬事俱備，卻仍欠一事尚未辦妥，凌凌等嘗試幫忙，怎料真的生出「離愁別緒」。熊家眾人察覺城安、凌凌等人有不妥，瑞素此時更意外發現城安整理的葬禮備忘錄。城安得悉眾人憂心他命不久矣，遂將計就計，欲從中得到好處……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#17粵PG
programme.desc: 邵玲以感化官身分為雅文求情，邵文終判雅文「殘酷對待動物」罪成，輕判兩年感化令。及後，惠知當面質疑邵文判刑草率……當晚，邵玲發現雅文的母親開直播怒罵，並持刀威脅雅文。邵玲趕往現場，竟見雅文之母身中多刀垂危。外界紛紛譴責邵文錯放兇手，仕途受阻，使邵玲自責。惠知審理此案，被告雅文辯稱是自衛，法醫卻指不合理，因傷者傷勢嚴重，不符合自衛所需的武力。案件陷入膠着，此時邵玲發現自己的筆記簿有異，揭示另有內情……

programme.title: 大生意人#12粵普
programme.desc: 古平原透過徐三從俄羅斯人手上購入大批軍火並運回安徽，恭親王看見後大喜，更推薦古平原為安撫使，古平原趁機拜託恭親王調查父親的下落。古平原隻身前往合肥城內勸說李成，最後李成答應讓百姓和不願留下的士兵離開…

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 太極樂隊成軍四十年，五子到臨錄影廠，暢談巡唱香港站內容及往後的巡唱計劃。合作難免有分歧，他們卻認為成員之間互相欣賞，是眾人可夾Band足四十年的原因！他們更會即席高歌一曲<頂天立地。轉季易令人出現氣管問題，而室內空氣質素低亦可引致不適，室內環境有何通常存在的污染物？使用空氣清新劑，或會令情況適得其反？此外，呼吸系統科醫生亦帶來有助改善家居空氣質素的方法。「睇餸食飯」，三姐奉上「芝麻醋香軟殼蟹」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 前列腺可以說是中年男士最常面對的問題，50歲以上的男性當中，每10人便有約4人(40%)，情況頗為嚴重。節目這次請來煒烈，細談面對前列腺增生的問題。本集也有泌尿科李卓暉醫生為大家解構何謂「前列腺增生」與箇中成因，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會跟大家分享與前列腺增生相關的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#12粵
programme.desc: 永禎向雙春與九妹提到將到飛揚的貿易公司工作。永禎隨曼娣與勝天出外入貨選購人參，當曼娣二人到另一處查看貨辦之際，竟有店員刻意接近永禎欲行賄他……永禎與利是妹談到營商比做老千更易賺錢，更想借此機會了解父親犯事原因。若嵐吃了飛揚所製的水餃，憶起昔日回憶。勝天與金鳳遊郊外，兩人感情又邁進一步。飛揚發覺若嵐特意約永禎到關家，要他吃若嵐自己所包的水餃，心生不滿。飛揚夢到昔日自己如何妒忌若嵐與安山的關係。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#80粵
programme.desc: 消防員欲破門而入，原來家中傳出不明氣體只是婷不潔的球鞋發出氣味。大廈維修停水停電，眾人上街擔水，缺少運動的眾人均不支。有義、有情及溢滿見勢色不對，竟計劃集體逃亡。可是蕙婷發燒厲害，溢滿取消逃亡行動。

programme.title: 尚食#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿親自送膳，憑口才令皇上留下孟尚食送來的幾道菜。胡尚食準備的炮豚呈現祥瑞圖紋博得皇上歡心，明火卻不慎點燃龍袍。宴席突現刺客，瞻基因護駕不力遭皇上指責。胡尚食自知落敗，邀子衿見面，而後借月華之手自盡。

programme.title: 我係小廚神2粵
programme.desc: 十八位參賽小朋友分成六組，在三十分鐘之內炮製自選菜式，拼盡全力在麥潔兒、陳國強、楊國基三位星級評判的手上，爭奪七個出線資格。各小廚神磨刀霍霍，以黑白胡椒蝦、夏威夷漢堡包等菜式迎戰，誰人可以脫穎而出？

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 機械城足球隊

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 機械城足球隊
programme.desc: 每天放學後，機器人艾力都會和朋友們在森林公園的小足球場一起踢足球。有人內向，有人天才，有人愛搞怪，各式各樣的人集結成一支很棒的隊伍，展開一段熱血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 機械城足球隊

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Dunny
programme.desc: Mum bans the girls from saying the word 'dunny' because it's not a word the Queen of England would use, but the kids try and trick her into saying it anyway.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Lar Gibbons
programme.desc: Andy encounters some baby Lar Gibbons in Thailand that appear to be flying as they swing through the rainforest.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Tubes
programme.desc: Bella and Lift enjoy making funny honk noises with tubes. They visit Tincy the Spider, who uses terrific tubes to make music with the Playtimers.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Making Friends Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are off for a Jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Boreal Forest, Canada
programme.desc: Glitch travels to Ontario to find a new teddy bear, but things start to go very wrong...

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Map Readers
programme.desc: Glitch races the Go Jetters across the Academy to find the lost G.O. Dome of the Ancients.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - First Day on Sodor!
programme.desc: Darcy the tunnel boring machine makes some mistakes on her first day, but she soon makes up for it when everyone sees what she can really do.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Plate Escape
programme.desc: Sarah, Duck and Plate Girl find some unusual inhabitants in the Plant Section at the shop.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Rainbow's Niece
programme.desc: Sarah's new colour wheel reminds Rainbow that he has not seen his niece in a while.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bell
programme.desc: The Town Hall clock is broken, it's lost its Ding Dong. It will take hours to fix, so Stanley asks noisy Fred if he will shout "DING DONG" when the big hand is pointing up.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Bus-Train
programme.desc: Cynthia is working on the bus so asks Stanley to take her passengers to the community centre. He uses Amare's tractor and trailer, his car, a boat, and a bath to make a Bus-Train.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - Sometimes I Make Cakes
programme.desc: Flipping pancakes, baking cakes, and homemade sauce from the shops, the animals share all the things they love about cooking.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Bake Gingerbread Pandas
programme.desc: It's snowing outside, but JoJo and Gran Gran are cosy in the kitchen making gingerbread biscuits. JoJo knows exactly what shape to make. There's plenty of help from Ned, Monty and Jared too.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Dragon
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Party Badge
programme.desc: Bing Bong - there's somebody at the door. It's delivery Chipmunk with a parcel for Duggee, but why is it wrapped up like a present? Maybe its Duggee's birthday!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Playing Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing in the clubhouse. Naughty Monkey arrives and causes chaos! He later returns to his home to relax when there is a knock at his door. It's his cousins, come to visit.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Calm Down
programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Go Jetter Heroes: Amelia Earhart
programme.desc: Inspired by her hero Amelia Earhart, Xuli attempts a solo flight across the Atlantic.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Grapefruit
programme.desc: Grapefruit dedicates the song "All My Friends" to the pals who go with her everywhere.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Leek
programme.desc: Leek won't let the conditions backstage stop him from singing "Can't Hold Me Down".

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it's not Evil Pea after all.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Carrot Powers Up
programme.desc: Carrot wants to become super strong, so she restores Evil Pea's robot suit for herself.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Listen
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter -the sole witness- mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. _x000D_An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Faces of Africa

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Truth Be Told
programme.desc: During her last days on Earth, Aja decides to tell Steve the truth: she's an alien. But her plans are complicated when the Zerons abduct Aja, Steve and Krel. Meanwhile, Vex struggles with an impossible choice: saving the Royal teens or the Royal Cores.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Last Night on Earth
programme.desc: With the Mothership ready for liftoff, Aja and Krel celebrate their last day on Earth at Battle of the Bands. But their world is rocked when Zadra arrives with a startling revelation about Vex - and a new enemy threatens their departure.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - No Dragon Left Behind
programme.desc: After being ambushed by aggressive Slitherwing dragons on a new island, the Riders think Stormfly has been poisoned and race to get an antidote

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Snuffnut
programme.desc: Tuff fakes his own death to make room for Throk, but when Ruff tries to train the Changewing that she thinks ate Tuff, a flock of angry Changewings come for the dragon

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - Searching For Oswald And Chicken
programme.desc: On a search for Dagur's dad, Hiccup and Dagur encounter vicious Grim Gnashers, and Tuff's search for a missing Chicken leads him to discover she has a second family

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Chet Vs Dr. Disorder Damselfly In Distress
programme.desc: Chet becomes obsessed with tracking down a litterbug who is messing up the clean streets of Turbotown. The FAST crew must compete against each other as they run a dangerous obstacle course race to save a damselfly princess who is being held captive.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Dome Sweet Dome My Pet Clamsquatch
programme.desc: Chet accidentally trades all of the town's tomatoes to the devious Ace Gecko and the FAST crew has to outsmart the lizard in order to get them back. Skidmark has been secretly keeping a clamsquatch as a pet and it's up to the crew to protect the creature from a nefarious secret organization.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Chicken Has Landed The Night of the Nibbler
programme.desc: Archibald takes an unexpected trip to outer space. When a yummy recipe goes missing, Archibald P.I. sets out to crack the case.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Anchor
programme.desc: The Ninjas are giving a special display of acrobatics and climbing to Noddy, the Pirates and the Knights. It looks amazing! Noddy goes back to Toy Green to tell Big Ears all about it and narrowly misses being run over by the runaway Pirates Galleon. Someone has taken their sticky anchor and without it they've no way of stopping the ship! Noddy needs to investigate before there's an accident! He follows all the clues which leads him to the Knights.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Disappearing Traffic Cones
programme.desc: When the Builders' traffic cones disappear from their building site, there is chaos all over Brickabuild. Noddy decides to investigate right away and find out who's taken them. Did the Naughticorns take them for their obstacle course? Or was it Farmer Tom who used them to keep his animals under control. Noddy carefully follows the clues and at last discovers it was the Pirates who took them to use as markers for Stripes' Pirate Galleon Driving Test.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Disappearing Special Things
programme.desc: When Fuse's collection of Special Things goes missing, Noddy vows to track them down. He soon works out that Bling was in Fuse's Workshop but it turns out that she just went in to add a Special Thing to Fuse's collection. More clues lead Noddy to Smartysaurus. She admits she went into Fuse's Workshop but tripped on an oil can and fled when she saw all the mess she'd made. As for the Special Things, they'd already gone when she got there.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Grey Coins
programme.desc: The Captain is upset because all of his shiny gold coins have been painted grey. It's a disaster as far as the pirates are concerned! Noddy decides to investigate. He realises that the grey coins are actually the gold coin covered with paint. They're not the only things that have turned grey too - Deltoid's shiny gold medal has been painted grey too.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Puffadder Sheds His Skin
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Puff Adder didn't shed his skin. All the animals were afraid of Puff Adder because he was very difficult to see and he had a nasty bite. Puff Adder decides that if no beast wants to be his friend then he doesn't want to have any friends. He slithers far, far away to the desert where he bumps into Camel and learns that every animal needs a friend. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Eagle Rules The Skies
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Eagle didn't rule the skies. She was a humble bird who kept herself to self. But then one day things start going wrong for the birds - some beast steals Hen's eggs, Hummingbird loses her hum and Tickbird goes missing! Eagle quietly saves the day and Lion rewards her with half his Kingdom. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Cornish Caper
programme.desc: Ted Glenn's Cornish cousin Ned is sending him a steam engine as an alternative means to power his workshop. Pat and Jess set off to Cornwall to collect this very large special delivery in the SDS Plane whilst Ted sets about giving away all of his old inventions to the people of Greendale in order to clear out enough space for the engine. Pat and Jess meet the eccentric Ned Glenn at his workshop and wrestle with the crate containing the heavy engine to get it aboard the plane.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Giant Pumpkin
programme.desc: Pat has to deliver some pumpkins to Greendale School for the annual Halloween Pumpkin Party. But when he picks them up from Ted's workshop, Jess starts playing with a giant pumpkin and it rolls into the river and floats away. Pat follows it along the river and tries to fish it out with Alf's rod but the pumpkin is too heavy and the line breaks. As the party gets under way in Greendale, the giant pumpkin floats out to sea and Pat and Jess board the SDS Orca and head out into Pencaster Bay.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - High-Tech Overload
programme.desc: Big Chris has got a new gadget to monitor the cars. He puts it to the test, what could possibly go wrong?!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Workshop Chaos
programme.desc: Big Chris is furious when Marsha tidies up his workshop - how's he supposed to work in these conditions? Luckily Flash saves helps out by messing it up again!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Shapes Up
programme.desc: Conrod is having an engine tune up at Silver Hatch. He boasts that his spoilers make him faster than all the other cars… who then want to be just as fast as their V8 hero…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Pit Stop Perils
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is fed up with Roary and Maxi constantly bickering about who is the fastest car at Silver Hatch. He decrees that the pair will have a race, and whoever wins, is the fastest - no more arguing!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Lost Space Rocket
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is going to launch into space in her all-new super space rocket. But as her friends all watch on the Daredale Big Screen, the picture suddenly goes dead! Noddy investigates to find out what happened to Smartysaurus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Smartysaurus's Jet Pack
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is trying out her new jet pack, but she hasn't read the instructions before taking off and cannot control it properly. Noddy investigates to help her control it before things get too dangerous.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Topsy Turvy Trees
programme.desc: All is set for the Toy Green Picnic until Noddy finds some of the trees turned upside down! Was it the Ninjas climbing on them? Or the Pirates wanting an upside-down tree for Pirate Bay? Noddy launches an investigation to find out who's behind all this.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Golden Thing
programme.desc: The Knights have found a mysterious Golden Thing. But the Pirates insist it's their Golden Thing. Noddy tries to settle the argument by investigating: Who is the owner of the Golden Thing? He soon finds more and more Golden Things have been hidden all over Toyland.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Happy CAT-O-Ween
programme.desc: It’s Cat-O-Ween in the dollhouse, and all the Gabby Cats are in the holiday spirit. Gabby and Pandy dress up and go trick-or-treating around the dollhouse, where they make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for hidden treats with MerCat, and make Banana ghosts with Cakey. Along the way, CatRat plays silly tricks on them, but in the end Floyd manages to trick them all! For the Cat of the Day segment, all the Gabby Cats sing a special Cat-O-Ween song.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - A Cat-Tabulous Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas time in the dollhouse! After putting the final topper on the Christmas tree, Figgy the Elf calls and says that Santa Kitty needs help in his workshop, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go help her out. After some toy fixing and boxing fun, Gabby and Pandy get to meet Santa Kitty and his Kitty reindeer and join him delivering presents to all their friends in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Rodney J. Dinkle, Babysitter Lights Out
programme.desc: When accident-prone Rodney gets hired to babysit a mischievous toddler, TZG secretly watches over their safety. When there’s a power outage in Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly helps the townsfolk beat the blackout.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Gratitude
programme.desc: When Phoebe’s Gratitude Day card flies away before she can give it to Marcus, the Dews try to help her recreate it - perfectly. But they learn that you don't have to be perfect to show your gratitude for someone. When Athena finds herself a little short-handed at the Fairhaven Summer Fair, her cousin, Reed, comes to help; only to give Athena more problems to fix.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Lost Space Rocket
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is going to launch into space in her all-new super space rocket. But as her friends all watch on the Daredale Big Screen, the picture suddenly goes dead! Noddy investigates to find out what happened to Smartysaurus.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when there's no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the "Whoopsies!" Song.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - She Said, She Said Starfish
programme.desc: When one of Rikki’s plants won't sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about; but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Leroy’s Caterpillar Lost Spark
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Ding Dong Day \ Grand Sam
programme.desc: It’s Pawston’s annual Take Your Kid to Work Day, and it’s Tag’s year to spend the day at the Doorbell Store with Paw. \ Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to complete an obstacle course in the woods.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Clucky Day \ Take Me Out to the Fetch Game
programme.desc: Scooch is bummed out because he’s missing his favorite holiday back in his old farm town, so Tag wants to cheer him up by rounding up some chickens and bringing Clucky Day to Pawston. \ When there’s a schedule mix-up and the Pawston Get Sox players think they have a day off, it’s up to Tag and Scooch to round up all five players in time for the fetch game, so that they don’t have to forfeit.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Scrapadactyls
programme.desc: When Revvit and his Reptool friends venture out of their ravine, the Dinotrux band together to save them from a flock of savage Scrapadactyls.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Back To The Starting Line
programme.desc: As a new term begins, Maricela and her horse, Mystery, arrive at the academy to join Lucky, Pru and Abigail for the school year.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Punch Thunk Love Nay Boors
programme.desc: When Eep and the others try to intervene with Thunk and Blurg's first date, they decide to run away so they can live happily ever after; Snoot and Ugga race each other to get to the Doomsday Skunkguin but are forced to put their differences aside once the weirder animals come out to hunt them down

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Caverns And Creepers Rad Teacher
programme.desc: When Eep is kicked out of Thunk's new imaginary role-playing adventure game she decides to play her own, real version of the game; Fed up with Squawk's mean teaching style, Eep has Grug fire him and replace him with Rad, the quintessential young, cool teacher

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Edge Of Disaster Pt 1
programme.desc: When Ruffnut is captured by Dragon Hunters, it's up to Astrid and Tuffnut to defend Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army Dragon's Edge from the invading Dragon Hunter army

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Baby Boss
programme.desc: Mom and Dad are panicking after Gigi noticed Boss isn't growing, so Boss "puts himself under", taking a special formula that will turn him int a regular baby long enough to pass a Doctor's checkup.
